Bae Jun-ho.summary: Bae Jun-ho is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Stoke City who adds half-turn receiving, tight-space passing, and final-third invention.
Bae Jun-ho.note: Jun-ho's edge is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Bae Jun-ho.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Cho Gue-sung.summary: Cho Gue-sung is a South Korea centre-forward from FC Midtjylland who gives the national team aerial presence, hold-up play, and penalty-box finishing.
Cho Gue-sung.note: Gue-sung's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Cho Gue-sung.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Cho Wi-je.summary: Cho Wi-je is a South Korea centre-back from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds size, man-marking, and aerial defending to the squad.
Cho Wi-je.note: Wi-je is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Cho Wi-je.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Eom Ji-sung.summary: Eom Ji-sung is a South Korea winger from Swansea City who adds one-on-one dribbling, inside carries, and bench attacking tempo.
Eom Ji-sung.note: Watch Ji-sung for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Eom Ji-sung.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Hwang Hee-chan.summary: Hwang Hee-chan is a South Korea forward from Wolverhampton Wanderers who adds explosive pressing, channel running, and direct penalty-box threat.
Hwang Hee-chan.note: Hee-chan is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Hwang Hee-chan.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Hwang In-beom.summary: Hwang In-beom is a South Korea midfielder from Feyenoord who gives the national team build-up passing, pressure resistance, and set-piece quality.
Hwang In-beom.note: In-beom is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Hwang In-beom.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jens Castrop.summary: Jens Castrop is a South Korea central midfielder from Borussia Mönchengladbach who adds Bundesliga intensity, duel pressure, and two-way running.
Jens Castrop.note: Castrop stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jens Castrop.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jo Hyeon-woo.summary: Jo Hyeon-woo is a South Korea goalkeeper from Ulsan HD who adds reflex saves, tournament experience, and command of the box.
Jo Hyeon-woo.note: Hyeon-woo stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Jo Hyeon-woo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Kim Jin-gyu.summary: Kim Jin-gyu is a South Korea central midfielder from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds simple circulation, late support, and domestic rhythm.
Kim Jin-gyu.note: Watch Jin-gyu for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Kim Jin-gyu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kim Min-jae.summary: Kim Min-jae is a South Korea centre-back from Bayern Munich who gives the national team elite defending, recovery speed, and line-breaking passes.
Kim Min-jae.note: Watch Min-jae for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Kim Min-jae.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kim Moon-hwan.summary: Kim Moon-hwan is a South Korea right-back from Daejeon Hana Citizen who adds overlap timing, wide defending, and tournament experience.
Kim Moon-hwan.note: Watch Moon-hwan for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Kim Moon-hwan.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Kim Seung-gyu.summary: Kim Seung-gyu is a South Korea goalkeeper from FC Tokyo who brings experience, distribution, and shot-stopping command.
Kim Seung-gyu.note: Seung-gyu stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Kim Seung-gyu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kim Tae-hyeon.summary: Kim Tae-hyeon is a South Korea defender from Kashima Antlers who adds left-footed centre-back cover, recovery defending, and aerial strength.
Kim Tae-hyeon.note: Tae-hyeon is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kim Tae-hyeon.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lee Dong-gyeong.summary: Lee Dong-gyeong is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Ulsan HD who adds left-footed passing, shooting range, and between-lines creativity.
Lee Dong-gyeong.note: Watch Dong-gyeong for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Lee Dong-gyeong.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Lee Gi-hyuk.summary: Lee Gi-hyuk is a South Korea defender from Gangwon FC who adds left-footed centre-back play, composure, and flexible build-up options.
Lee Gi-hyuk.note: Gi-hyuk is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Lee Gi-hyuk.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Lee Han-beom.summary: Lee Han-beom is a South Korea centre-back from FC Midtjylland who adds European experience, aerial defending, and recovery power.
Lee Han-beom.note: Han-beom is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Lee Han-beom.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Lee Jae-sung.summary: Lee Jae-sung is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Mainz 05 who adds pressing intelligence, link play, and late box arrivals.
Lee Jae-sung.note: Jae-sung stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Lee Jae-sung.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Lee Kang-in.summary: Lee Kang-in is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Paris Saint-Germain who adds elite ball security, left-footed creation, and set-piece delivery.
Lee Kang-in.note: Kang-in's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Lee Kang-in.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Lee Tae-seok.summary: Lee Tae-seok is a South Korea left-back from Austria Wien who adds width, crossing range, and progressive carries down the flank.
Lee Tae-seok.note: Tae-seok stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Lee Tae-seok.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Oh Hyeon-gyu.summary: Oh Hyeon-gyu is a South Korea centre-forward from Beşiktaş who adds strength, penalty-box movement, and direct finishing.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.note: Hyeon-gyu stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Paik Seung-ho.summary: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korea central midfielder from Birmingham City who adds deep passing, tempo control, and ball-winning balance.
Paik Seung-ho.note: Seung-ho's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Paik Seung-ho.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Park Jin-seob.summary: Park Jin-seob is a South Korea defensive midfielder from Zhejiang FC who adds screening, centre-back cover, and aerial bite.
Park Jin-seob.note: Jin-seob's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Park Jin-seob.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Seol Young-woo.summary: Seol Young-woo is a South Korea right-back from Red Star Belgrade who adds two-sided full-back cover, recovery speed, and attacking support.
Seol Young-woo.note: Watch Young-woo for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Seol Young-woo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Son Heung-min.summary: Son Heung-min is South Korea's captain and Los Angeles FC forward, giving the national team elite movement, two-footed finishing, and transition threat.
Son Heung-min.note: Heung-min's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Son Heung-min.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Song Bum-keun.summary: Song Bum-keun is a South Korea goalkeeper from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds shot-stopping depth, size, and domestic rhythm.
Song Bum-keun.note: Bum-keun's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Song Bum-keun.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yang Hyun-jun.summary: Yang Hyun-jun is a South Korea winger from Celtic who adds direct dribbling, right-side speed, and one-on-one pressure.
Yang Hyun-jun.note: Hyun-jun's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yang Hyun-jun.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。
